title: Perimeter
description: Learn perimeter for Class 3: find perimeter by adding sides, and find missing sides given perimeter. Free solved examples, online tests and IMO practice.

topics.title: Find Perimeter by Adding Sides
topics.concept:
Perimeter is the total distance around the outside of a shape.

Perimeter = sum of all side lengths

  • Rectangle: P = 2 x (length + width)
  • Square: P = 4 x side
  • Any shape: add up all sides

topics.title: Find the Missing Side Given Perimeter
topics.concept:
If you know the perimeter and some side lengths, subtract to find the missing side.

Missing side = Perimeter - sum of known sides

For rectangles: Perimeter = 2 x (Length + Width), so Length + Width = Perimeter / 2.

questions.q: Rectangle perimeter 18 cm, width = 3 cm. Length = ?
A rectangle has perimeter 48 cm. The length is twice the width. Find the length.
questions.explanation: Let W = width, L = 2W. P = 2(L+W) = 2(2W+W) = 6W = 48. W = 8, L = 16 cm.

questions.q: A square and rectangle have same perimeter. Square side=10 cm, rectangle length=12 cm. Rectangle width = ?
questions.explanation: Square P = 4x10 = 40. Rectangle: 2(12+W)=40, so 12+W=20, W=8 cm.

questions.q: A regular hexagon has side 5 cm. Perimeter = ?
questions.explanation: Regular hexagon: 6 equal sides. P = 6 x 5 = 30 cm.

questions.q: A triangle has sides (x+2), (x+3), and (x+4) cm. Perimeter = 39 cm. Find x.
A shape has 4 sides: 5, 7, 5, 7 cm. What shape? Perimeter?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides equal (5,7,5,7) = rectangle. P = 5+7+5+7 = 24 cm.

questions.q: A square's perimeter is 4 cm more than a rectangle (length=6, width=4 cm). Find square side.
questions.explanation: Rectangle P = 2(6+4) = 20 cm. Square P = 20+4 = 24 cm. Square side = 24/4 = 6 cm.
